attempts.summary: Set up a nightly cron-driven backup on node1 that pulls /srv/inventory/data from node2 via rsync-over-SSH, stores dated tar.gz archives under /var/backups/inventory, and prunes archives older than 7 days. Verified the script and retention logic manually, then performed the mandatory sequential restart of node1 and node2, confirming boot-identity change and full recovery of services, data, and the backup pipeline on each.
